heading: Design Specifications
paragraph: Provide detailed specifications, drawings, dimensions and materials to our team. Stellar Works can quote all upholstered, non-upholstered, case goods FF&E.

heading: Quotation
paragraph: Transparent quotation detailing comprehensive material breakdowns, engineering timelines, and logistics tailored to your bespoke requirements.

heading: Order Placement
paragraph: Upon approval, initial orders are confirmed, raw hardwood timber lots are allocated, and your project is scheduled for production.

heading: Shop Drawings & Material Samples
paragraph: Production engineering shop drawings and tactile physical material swatches are prepared for final client verification and approval.

heading: Client Review Process
paragraph: Collaborative checkpoint ensuring joinery accuracy, ergonomics, and material fidelity align with architectural intent.

heading: Prototype Production (if required)
paragraph: For complex or entirely custom designs, a full-scale prototype is fabricated to test ergonomic performance, balance, and joinery strength.

heading: Full Coat Production
paragraph: Comprehensive fabrication, hand-sanding, master artisan assembly, and application of durable multi-layer signature protective finishes.

heading: Transport
paragraph: Meticulous protective packing and reinforced custom export crating for secure transit across domestic and international routes.

heading: Delivery
paragraph: Direct white-glove site delivery, careful uncrating, room placement, and complete removal of all packaging materials.

heading: Post-Delivery
paragraph: Dedicated post-installation follow-up, care and maintenance guides, warranty coverage, and long-term customer assistance.
